input.claim_text: On 8 February 2024 my son was kicking a soccer ball in the backyard and it smashed straight through our sliding glass door. The whole pane shattered and we've had to board it up until it can be replaced. I think it'll cost around $650 to fix.

output.cause: soccer ball kicked into sliding glass door

input.query: Accidental breakage of glass door caused by family member/child, is this covered?

turns.text:
DECISION: approve

The claim is for accidental breakage of a sliding glass door caused by a soccer ball, which falls under RAA's "Accidental breakage of glass and sanitary fixtures" additional benefit. The damaged item (glass door) is not among the listed exclusions (scratches, glasshouse glass, tiles/splashbacks, toilet seats, stove/heater glass, TV screens, or glass ornaments/frames) [RAA Contents PDS, page 52]. There is no indication of intentional damage or any conflicting general exclusion evident from the retrieved text.

Using the policyholder's certificate figures: excess = $500, coverage limit = $45,000, claimed amount = $650.

Payout = $650 − $500 excess = **$150**.

Citations: [RAA Contents PDS, page 52]
